alloy.preparation: Arc melted under reduced argon on a water-cooled copper hearth, using 99.99 wt% pure metal chunks. Nominal alloy formula: CoCrFeNiAl0.6. Ground to 2000-grit SiC finish before electrochemical testing.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode flat cell: specimen working electrode, saturated calomel reference and platinum-mesh counter. OCP measured for 30 min for approximate stabilization; scanned from 150 mV below OCP to final 2.0 V SCE using a Biologic VMP under EC-Lab 10.02. At least four replicate tests conducted per alloy.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Authors’ reported Epit from the potentiodynamic response, distinct from Ecorr; no universal numerical current-density criterion for selecting Epit is specified.

experiments.result_note: Approximate graphical reading; Epit is distinct from the black-square Ecorr series. experiments.result_note: Approximate graphical reading; Epit is distinct from the black-square Ecorr series. Table 1 explicit value/printed uncertainty is primary. The paper does not identify the uncertainty as SD or SE. Figure 1 labels this alloy SPS whereas the Figure 2 caption/discussion calls it as cast; the shared summary/table result is retained with this processing-label conflict. Composition amounts are nominal formula coefficients, not measured bulk at% or wt%; implicit unit coefficients retain the chemical notation. No normalized fractions or balance are calculated. Parenthesized group coefficients remain in the formula rather than being divided among constituents. These HEAs are described as Mo-free and C-free in the Table 1 comparison; this is not a full measured elemental analysis. The as-cast AlCoCrCuFe microstructure is described as Cu-rich fcc plus a Cu-depleted bcc matrix; its applicability to the SPS-labelled summary entry cannot be settled, so the tested-state microstructure field is left empty.
